sources.excerpt: LEGITIMATE BEEF boost pedal Home HANDBUILT PEDALS MICRO PEDALS BARE BOX DEALS ACCESSORIES HANDBUILT PEDALS > LEGITIMATE BEEF boost pedal LEGITIMATE BEEF boost pedal SKU: $59.99 $59.99 Unavailable per item LEGITIMATE BEEF: The Chicago Stompworks recreation of the original Red Llama pedal - huge db output, warm crunch... this is THE solution for a tube amp front end. CD4049 chip, big 330uf cap - incredible amount of volume output from this pedal, and a super warm rumbly overdrive that doesn't thin out or lose ANY bottom end. Your tube front end wants to be driven by this pedal! No mods on this one, it's intended to be as close to the original as possible. -1590b sized enclosure (4.409" x 2.382" x1 .220") -handbuilt boutique quality throughout -true bypass, hand wired with high quality open frame jacks -"best in class" hand soldered, through-hole components -standard center negative "Boss style" 9v jack or internal battery current draw: 5ma Facebook Twitter Pinterest Google+ Quantity Sold Out Add to Cart FREE USA SHIPPING! for orders over $50 BIG MUFF and the Big Muff designs are trademarks of Electro-Harmonix/ New Sensor Corp. • RAT is a trademark of RAPCO INTERNATIONAL, INC • TUBE SCREAMER is a trademark of Hoshino Gakki Co., Ltd VOODOO LAB is a trademark of Digital Music Corp • ORANGE SQUEEZER and GREEN RINGER are trademarks of Dan Armstrong/AMPEG • MAESTRO is a trademark of the Gibson Guitar Corp. [1][2] - **Primary reference:** Way Huge **Red Llama** / Tube Sound Fuzz family. - Chicago Stompworks states that the circuit is intended to be as close to the original as possible without modifications. [1] - **CD4049 CMOS IC** is documented. [1] - No discrete transistor complement is assigned. - Exact control labeling follows the simple Red Llama-style boost/drive concept. - **1590B enclosure** - Hand-wired jacks. - True bypass. [2] The builder positions Legitimate Beef as a warm, rumbly and unusually loud boost/overdrive that preserves low end and is intended to push an amplifier's front end.
